item.title: proxmox-boot-tool kernel pin silently ineffective with GRUB + ZFS root when NVMe device names change between boots
item.author: invalid@example.com (iklesov)
item.dc:creator: iklesov
item.content:encoded:
On a host with ZFS root (rpool on NVMe), UEFI boot via GRUB managed by proxmox-boot-tool, and many NVMe devices (HPE DL360 Gen11, boot device HPE NS204i-u plus 8 data NVMe), proxmox-boot-tool kernel pin has no effect.

Cause
With ZFS root, grub-mkconfig has no filesystem UUID, so the menu entry IDs contain the device path, e.g.:
Code: 
gnulinux-advanced-/dev/nvme0n1p3>gnulinux-7.0.14-17-pve-advanced-/dev/nvme0n1p3
